headline: Univastu wins Rs 24.36 lakh order from L&T for MMRDA Line 4
summary: Univastu secured a confirmed work order worth Rs 24.36 lakh from Larsen & Toubro for E&M works at Gaimukh Inspection Pit. The firm maintains a robust order book of Rs 601.46 crore, representing 7.53 quarters of average revenue.

headline: Apsis Aerocom wins Rs 4.30 crore order from Healthcare client
summary: Company secures confirmed work order worth Rs 4.296867 crore from a local Healthcare customer. Execution within 7 months. TTM revenue is zero, making book-to-bill metrics unavailable.

headline: Mason Infratech secures Rs 12.9 crore order from Cowtown Infotech
summary: Mason Infratech wins a significant Rs 12.9 crore order for core and shell civil work at Palava Waterfront T2. The 18-month contract adds to its Q2FY27 inflow, bringing total disclosed orders to Rs 23.51 crore.

headline: Bikewo Green Tech wins Rs 66.46 crore order from Reliance
summary: Company secures confirmed work order for EV tractor hiring and operation services. Contract runs till July 2033 with pro-rata payments. Filing notes values are indicative estimates.

headline: Eicher Motors launches Flying Flea C6 in Europe
summary: Eicher Motors expands its electric mobility brand Flying Flea to five European cities with the C6 launch. Priced at €5,990, the bike features 104 km range and advanced tech.

headline: Vedant Fashions pays ₹50,000 fine for label violation
summary: Vedant Fashions Limited settled a Legal Metrology violation regarding missing size labels on a Sherwani by paying a ₹50,000 compounding fee to the Delhi authorities in September 2026.

headline: Quint Digital CCPS and Warrants to List on BSE
summary: Quint Digital Ltd has received listing approval for its partly paid-up CCPS and warrants on BSE. Trading commences September 18, 2026. The rights issue includes 82.6 lakh units of each security.

headline: Tahmar Enterprises gets Maharashtra excise IMFL permit
summary: Tahmar Enterprises has received permission from Maharashtra Excise to manufacture IMFL from grain-based spirit, marking a key regulatory milestone for the company.

headline: Railtel Wins Rs 63.15 Cr Order from Prasar Bharti for WAVES OTT
summary: Railtel secured a Rs 63.15 crore Letter of Intent from Prasar Bharti for additional features on the WAVES OTT Platform. This adds to the company's growing order book, bringing total disclosed orders to Rs 2961.22 crore across 46 deals.

headline: Stocks in Focus: Tahmar, Infosys, Mazagon Dock
summary: Tahmar Enterprises surges 20% on IMFL nod. Infosys expands AI hub. Mazagon Dock signs greenfield shipyard MoU. Fortis wins Delhi hospital deal. Tempsens posts profit growth.

headline: Onmobile Global audit panel probes operational concerns
summary: A consultant has raised concerns about possible operational issues at Onmobile Global. The audit committee has engaged an independent law firm to investigate the matter.

headline: Goodricke Group sells art assets for ₹27.75 crore
summary: Goodricke Group Limited sold non-core art assets via auction for ₹27.75 crore, crossing materiality thresholds. The transaction aims to unlock value and focus on core business operations.

headline: HGM acquires 1.45% stake in XBP Global for $579,997
summary: HandsOn Global Management (HGM) Ltd acquired a 1.45% stake in XBP Global Holdings Inc for US$579,997 via private placement. The investment aligns with HGM's strategy to integrate AI-led automation into critical workflows.

headline: Bhangdiya family triggers open offer for 26% stake in GSL Securities
summary: The Bhangdiya family has triggered an open offer to acquire a 26% stake in GSL Securities at ₹42 per share. The move follows a share purchase agreement for a 44.62% block from the promoter group, marking a change in control.
